items.title: Legal Aspects and Data Privacy Laws

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Legal Aspects and Data Privacy Laws under 9.5 as printed (PDF 135-136, printed 131-132).

blocks.text: Legal aspects of computing refer to the rules and regulations that govern the use of technology and digital information. Cybercrime refers to illegal activities carried out using computers, networks, or the internet, such as hacking, identity theft, and online fraud. These laws protect individuals, organizations, and society from misuse of data and technology. Data privacy laws ensure that personal and sensitive information is collected, stored, and shared responsibly. Understanding these laws helps prevent legal issues and promotes safe digital practices. Compliance with legal frameworks also encourages trust in online systems and services.
